September 9 - November 18, 2026  
Led by Kurt Joyce & Meghann Saige Volz  
@kurt.moves @meghannsaige   
The River Yoga’s 10-week 200-Hour Yoga Teacher Training is an immersive exploration of the practice, philosophy, anatomy, energetics, ethics, and business of yoga.  
You will leave this training with an expanded understanding of yoga, a deeper self-awareness, and the tools to confidently and safely lead vinyasa classes - in your own voice.
